subject: POC plan & final readout scheduling — Acme Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@acme-health.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up & POC plan — Acme Health discovery

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Use case: clinical notes summarization + intent extraction for triage routing.
- Priority success criteria (per your team): 1) >=92% recall on triage intents against your labelled set, 2) <250ms 95p latency on 512-token requests, and 3) no PHI leaves your VPC during the POC (private deployment).
- Proposed POC scope: 2-week trial using a subset of production-like data (10k notes), initial model baselines, and readout with your execs.

Next steps:
1) Confirm technical owner and legal/procurement contacts (you mentioned Diego for infra and procurement@acme-health.com for contracting).
2) Confirm target week for final readout (we propose week of Nov 9).
3) I'll loop in Rishi (solutions) and Marcus (sales lead) to propose a detailed evaluation plan and timeline.

Attached: initial POC scope + mutual action plan.

If that all looks right, can you confirm stakeholders and the readout week?

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0142

From: Samantha Green <samantha.green@acme-health.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Diego Ramirez <diego.ramirez@acme-health.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acme-health.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & POC plan — Acme Health discovery

Thanks Marissa — this looks good and thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Technical owner: Diego Ramirez (cc'd) will own infra and data access.
- Success criteria: we can confirm the recall target and latency; for PHI constraint we need to ensure KMS integration and that logs are retained in our account — Diego can provide specifics.
- Timeline: week of Nov 9 works for an exec readout. We'll want a 30–45 minute slot for the executive summary + 60-minute technical deep dive with Diego and two of our engineers.

Diego — can you confirm availability for a kickoff the week of Oct 26 so we can start ingesting the sample dataset?

Samantha
VP Product, Acme Health
samantha.green@acme-health.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@acme-health.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-19T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & POC plan — Acme Health discovery

Hi Samantha / team — looping in proposed POC plan (technical). Short version below; full plan attached.

POC objectives / success criteria:
- Accuracy: target >=92% recall on intent labels over the seeded test set (we'll use your 2k labelled sample for validation).
- Performance: 95th percentile latency <250ms at expected concurrency (simulated 8 concurrent streams).
- Security: private deployment model, KMS integration for keys, agent-level audit logs — no data egress from your VPC.

Deliverables & ownership:
- Redwood: deploy private inference cluster, baseline model, initial prompts/eval harness, daily syncs during trial (Rishi).
- Acme: provide 10k sample notes (anonymized where feasible), labelled 2k test set, engineer for data access & KMS (Diego).

Timeline (proposed):
- Oct 26: kickoff + data handoff window opens
- Oct 26–Nov 6: ingestion, baseline runs, iterative tuning (2 weeks)
- Nov 9: final readout (exec summary + tech deep dive)

Evaluation plan:
- We'll run the evaluation harness daily with your labelled test set; weekly metrics report (precision/recall, F1, latency percentiles, cost per 1k tokens).
- We'll flag any regressions and propose mitigation (prompt changes, quantization profiles, fallback model variants).

Attachments: Acme_Health_POC_scope_v2.pdf (detailed tasks), Acme_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (roles + timeline).

Please review and let me know if we should adjust the timeline or success metrics. If this looks good, we can lock the kickoff for Oct 26 afternoon PST.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@acme-health.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Diego Ramirez <diego.ramirez@acme-health.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & POC plan — Acme Health discovery

Samantha — great, thanks for the quick turnaround and for confirming availability. 

I've tentatively booked the following: 
- Kickoff: Oct 26, 2:00–3:00pm PST (30-min operational kickoff + 30-min tech sync).
- POC window: Oct 26–Nov 6 (as Rishi outlined).
- Final readout (exec + tech): Nov 9, 11:00am–12:30pm PST (30-min exec summary, 60-min technical deep dive).

Marcus and I will coordinate internal exec attendees. For the readout decision process, can you confirm who will be in the go/no-go decision loop from Acme? Typical ask: product lead (Samantha), head of eng (TBD), and procurement for contracting approvals.

Also — procurement next steps: if the POC validates, we'll put together a term sheet and an initial draft SOW. Marcus, can you prepare a preliminary commercial outline we can share with procurement after the readout?

Thanks — looking forward to kickoff.

Best,
Marissa

From: Samantha Green <samantha.green@acme-health.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Diego Ramirez <diego.ramirez@acme-health.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acme-health.com>
Date: 2026-10-22T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & POC plan — Acme Health discovery

All — thanks. Kickoff time works for Diego and our engineers. Decision stakeholders for the final readout: myself (VP Product), Miguel Ortega (Head of Engineering), and our Procurement lead (procurement@acme-health.com).

Procurement note: we'll need a draft SOW and indicative pricing prior to the readout so the procurement team can do a light review — ideally 48 hours before Nov 9. Marcus, could you share a one-page commercial outline by Nov 7?

Diego — we'll coordinate the sample data handoff details offline; I'll loop you both into a separate calendar invite.

Appreciate the clear plan. Looking forward to the kickoff.

— Samantha
